method: Pretrained U-Net water segmentation + SCL quality mask
interpretation: Unitless indicators of optical change in clear open water; not measured chlorophyll, turbidity in NTU, pathogens, sewage, heavy metals or drinking-water safety. Field sampling and local calibration are required. Atmospheric correction, sun glint, shallow bottoms and floating vegetation can affect results. Shoreline pixels are eroded.
comparison_support: Same clear, open-water pixels at both dates; water areas include only observed eroded mask.
